title: Nature-therapy school Instagram profile on a phone leaning against giant green leather tubes
whatItIs: A phone displaying a profile with a green logo and a 3x3 grid of muted nature photos and green posts leans against a big sculptural stack of olive-green leather tubes on a dark base, in a brown-outlined cream frame.
whatItMeans: Calm and tactile; the green tubes echo the brand's palette.
